originalTitle: Autonomous Electric Aviation Startup Completes First Intercity Commuter Test Flight
originalContent: An aerospace technology firm has successfully demonstrated a fully autonomous electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft flight between two regional airport nodes. Powered by high-density lithium-sulfur battery packs, the prototype maintained zero direct carbon emissions throughout the fifty-mile route. Aviation safety regulators observed flight dynamics and automated collision avoidance system telemetry.
